# apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set (Resource)

Creates a Game Center matchmaking rule set, which holds the rules and teams that decide which players are matched. Add them with `apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule` and `apple_game_center_matchmaking_team`, and use the rule set in an `apple_game_center_matchmaking_queue`. Destroying the resource deletes the rule set with its rules and teams. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set" "ranked" {
  reference_name        = "Ranked"
  rule_language_version = 1
  min_players           = 2
  max_players           = 8
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_players` (Number) Most players in a match.
- `min_players` (Number) Fewest players in a match.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the rule set. Changing it creates a new rule set.
- `rule_language_version` (Number) Version of the rule expression language, e.g. `1`. Changing it creates a new rule set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the matchmaking rule set.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set.ranked
  identity = {
    id = "2e4a6c8b-0d1f-4b3a-9c5e-7f8a9b0c1d2f"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the matchmaking rule set.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set.ranked 2e4a6c8b-0d1f-4b3a-9c5e-7f8a9b0c1d2f
```
